items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: And Dan, I was raised with Dan. I knew Dan from a kid up, Dan Levy.

ctx.x: I don't remember that. I really don't. Yeah, he was down there.

Yeah, he could have been, I just don't remember. Well, we only played down there Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. And they were playing a spot job crisis down there. And Dan, I was raised with Dan. I knew Dan from a kid up, Dan Levy. And I told him, I says, Dan, I says, we're not taking enough money to pay one person in the band. I said, how long are you going to take this beating? They'll come. Don't worry. They'll come. Dan was loaded, you know. And when he gets so, he'd get loaded and couldn't talk. He didn't…
How long did you play with Jumbo?
